first_screen: Author abstract identifies cold-pressed flaxseed oil replacing part of anchovy oil in salmon feed. Swimming performance was similar in relevant groups. The assay measures swimming effort and recovery.
Author abstract identifies unrefined cold-pressed oil in rats on a fructose diet. Liver oxidation and serum lipids were measured, without movement testing.
Author abstract recovered through PubMed EFetch. First cold-pressed oil in equine feed was compared with sunflower oil or control. The endpoints were blood cell and fatty-acid measures.
Parkinson trial combined flaxseed-derived omega-3 and vitamin E. The accessible original reports total UPDRS and no individual resting-tremor result.
Original abstract and manuscript scope verify a nasal delivery carrier for ropinirole. Distribution endpoints do not establish a culinary exposure response.
Independent 40-person Parkinson trial with a combined supplement. Original Table 2 gives composite motor data, with no separate resting-tremor estimate.

Author abstract documents refined cold-pressed flaxseed oil compared with high-oleic sunflower oil in 59 adults with elevated blood pressure. Vascular and metabolic endpoints differ from the frozen outcome. Follow adverse-event reporting and preparation detail in the primary body.
Ethyl esters made from pressed oil were given to rabbits. The study measured hair composition and physical hair properties.

Ruminant feeding study used linseed oil as one urea-coating ingredient. Muscle tremors occurred in the uncoated urea group under acute ammonia toxicity. The formulation comparison does not isolate the oil or address a resting phenotype.
